Synopsis:
    Putin declared Russia is winning in Ukraine, dismissed mobilisation rumours, and labelled Zelenskiy's leadership as "terrorists" ruling out direct negotiations. He acknowledged drone damage to Russian refineries but claimed 90% repaired. Russia is advancing toward Sloviansk and Kramatorsk, with two Ukrainian troop groups reportedly encircled. U.S.-mediated peace talks remain stalled following the U.S.-Israel/Iran conflict in February. Putin signalled openness to Trump envoy-led talks but only toward a full resolution, not a freeze. He also dismissed German accusations over the Leipzig drone attack as politically motivated deflection.
